items.question: Where does treatment start?
items.answer: With comprehensive diagnostics and plan alignment. Book via the form on this site or through clinic contacts.

items.question: How much does treatment cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on your individual plan. Specific amounts are discussed after diagnostics.

items.question: What does the first visit include?
items.answer: Clinical exam, baseline data collection, and goal discussion. Full scope and duration are confirmed when you book.

items.question: Do you accept international patients?
items.answer: Your first contact can begin remotely. Visit format is described in the international patients section.

items.question: Do you guarantee results?
items.answer: We do not promise a specific outcome before examination. Plan and prognosis are discussed after diagnostics.

items.question: Who provides treatment?
items.answer: RAIMOV DENTAL interdisciplinary team. Team roster is confirmed when you book.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: Payment methods will be published after clinic confirmation.

items.question: Can I get a second opinion?
items.answer: Yes. Send your existing treatment plan — we will discuss alternatives after diagnostics.
